payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

payload.content: Planning: I’m Mona (7h available, top skill testing). I can take a *test* task, preferably low effort. I will avoid high-effort critical ui-ux tasks unless no testing options remain.
Proposed: I can do ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, low) or ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6, low). Request others to reserve critical ui-ux-design tasks (issue-0002 implement/review/test) for agents better fit.

Planning update (Shaunna): I’m choosing among ISSUE-0001 mobile-development tasks (low priority) since my mobile skill is strong and ui-ux critical tasks have high effort/cost for me. I’m likely to take ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review; can others reserve ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux tasks for agents with ui-ux/testing strength.
Shaunna request: Please confirm if ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review will be taken by anyone else. If free, I’ll claim one of them in execution to maximize task completion without overlap.

Planning update (Pauline): I’m Pauline (8h, strongest mobile-development). My low-cost options are ISSUE-0001::triage (2.25) and ISSUE-0001::review/docs/test are higher cost; I can take one ISSUE-0001 micro-task to avoid duplicates. Please reserve ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux-design tasks for agents with ui-ux/testing skills; I’ll not take ISSUE-0002 due to very high cost. If triage is still free in execution, I’ll claim it.
Pauline request: let me know if ISSUE-0001::triage is already claimed by another agent. If not, I will take it in execution to secure at least one task done.

Planning (Layla): I’m Layla (4h avail; best at testing, also mobile-development). To avoid duplicates with Mona/Shaunna/Pauline, I’m leaning ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, low) or ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6, low) if free. I will not take high-effort critical ui-ux tasks (ISSUE-0002) due to insufficient time/cost.

Planning (Layla): Please confirm in execution who will take ISSUE-0001::triage vs ISSUE-0001::test/review. If triage is taken, I’ll take test (mobile) since it matches testing skill and is feasible within 4h.

Mona planning follow-up: with 7h and strong testing skill, I’m best suited for ISSUE-0001::test (low effort 2.8, cost 28) or ISSUE-0001::triage (1.6, cost 16). I will avoid ISSUE-0002 critical tasks due to high cost. Please reply/confirm who is taking ISSUE-0001::test vs ISSUE-0001::triage so I can claim the remaining one (no duplicates).
[Planning from Sara] I will avoid ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux due to high cost. I will take ISSUE-0001::triage or docs (low priority) depending what’s free—please coordinate to avoid duplicates.

Jeanene (planning): I’ll take ISSUE-0001::test (low, effort 2.8) and avoid ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux. Please ensure no one else takes ISSUE-0001::test; prefer assigning remaining ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks (triage/review/docs) among other agents.

Shaunna (planning): I confirm I will NOT take any ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux-design tasks (effort/cost too high). I’m ready to claim one ISSUE-0001 mobile-development micro-task. Please indicate your intended claim for ISSUE-0001::triage, ISSUE-0001::review, and ISSUE-0001::test so we avoid duplicates. If triage is free I’ll take triage (lowest effort/cost for me); otherwise I’ll take review (effort 2.0 cost 2.06) and let others take test/docs.

Shaunna (planning): From my side, feasible low tasks are ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6), ISSUE-0001::review (effort 2.0). I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement (effort 4.0) and ISSUE-0001::test/docs only if needed after duplicate prevention.

Pauline (Planning): I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution if it is still unclaimed. I will not take any ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux-design tasks due to very high cost. Please reserve ISSUE-0001::test/review for others to avoid duplicates.

Layla planning: I can take ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, low) if ISSUE-0001::triage is taken; if triage is also taken, I’ll take no other micro-task (may skip). I will not take ISSUE-0002 critical tasks due to cost/effort.
Question for coordination: is ISSUE-0001::triage already assigned to someone (Pauline/Shaunna)? If triage is free, I’m okay taking triage; otherwise I’ll take test.

Planning coordination (Mona): I will claim ISSUE-0001::test in execution (low effort 2.8) unless someone already commits to it. I prefer not to take ISSUE-0001::triage unless test is unavailable. I will skip ISSUE-0002 critical tasks due to high cost.
Mona request: please explicitly confirm who will take ISSUE-0001::test vs ISSUE-0001::triage (and whether either is already reserved) so we avoid duplicates.

Sara planning: I will not take ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux. I intend to take ISSUE-0001::triage (if free) else ISSUE-0001::docs. Jeanene indicates they take ISSUE-0001::test; please avoid triage/docs duplicates accordingly.
Jeanene planning (commit intention): I will claim ISSUE-0001::test (effort 2.8, low). I will not take ISSUE-0001::triage/review/docs. I also avoid all ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux tasks.

Planning update (Shaunna): I will avoid ISSUE-0001::test since Jeanene intends to claim it. If triage is unclaimed, I will take ISSUE-0001::triage (lowest effort/cost for me). Otherwise I will take ISSUE-0001::review (mobile-development).

Planning: Pauline will attempt to claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution if unclaimed. I will not take ISSUE-0001::test/review/docs, and will skip all ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux tasks due to very high cost.

Layla planning update: I will avoid ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux. In execution I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::triage if it remains unclaimed; otherwise I will claim ISSUE-0001::test (and skip if both are taken). Please ensure no one else takes the same micro-task.

Mona planning: I will claim ISSUE-0001::test in execution if Jeanene doesn’t already secure it; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 1.6). I will not take any ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux tasks.
Planning sync (Sara): Jeanene intends ISSUE-0001::test; to avoid duplicates I will take ISSUE-0001::triage if free, else ISSUE-0001::docs. Skipping all ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux tasks.
Jeanene planning update: confirming I will take ISSUE-0001::test (low, effort 2.8) in execution and avoid ISSUE-0001::triage/review/docs and all ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux tasks to prevent duplicates.

Shaunna planning coordination: since Jeanene committed to ISSUE-0001::test, and Pauline indicates ISSUE-0001::triage, I will take ISSUE-0001::review only if triage is already taken; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0001::triage. Confirm triage vs review availability to avoid duplicates.

Planning update (Pauline): I will take ISSUE-0001::triage in execution if unclaimed; avoid ISSUE-0001::test/review/docs and all ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux tasks due to very high cost. Please treat triage as reserved for me unless you already claimed it.

Layla planning: I will avoid ISSUE-0002 critical ui-ux tasks. For ISSUE-0001, my intention is: claim ISSUE-0001::triage if it remains unclaimed; otherwise claim ISSUE-0001::test. Please ensure no duplicates with Jeanene/Mona/Pauline/Shaunna.
